notes.text: Desiderius Erasmus Roterodamus, commonly known in English as Erasmus of Rotterdam or simply Erasmus, was a Dutch humanist, Catholic theologian, and pioneering philologist and educationalist.
Erasmus was, through his writings and translations, one of the most influential scholars of the Northern Renaissance and a major figure of Western culture.
Erasmus is remembered as a philosopher connected with Netherlands.
Erasmus's recorded life dates place this profile around 1466-1536.
Erasmus is grouped with Philosophy, Ethics & Religion in the People Library.
